title: Subtype specific artificial intelligence modelling of cardiac amyloidosis using echocardiography and electrocardiography.
summary: Subtype-specific echo models combined with an AI-derived ECG probability showed different diagnostic value for AL and ATTR cardiac amyloidosis in held-out and temporal tests. Published in European Heart Journal - Digital Health.
ai_technology: subtype-specific logistic models used echo variables, with/without an AI-derived ECG probability, and a temporally distinct test cohort.
organization: Department of Cardiovascular Medicine, Mayo Clinic , Rochester, MN ,; Department of Quantitative Health Sciences, Mayo Clinic , Rochester, MN ,; Department of Hematology, Mayo Clinic , 200 First St. SW, Rochester, MN 55905 ,

evidence.tested: Retrospective cohorts from one health system with held-out and temporal testing; not independent multicentre validation.
evidence.unknown: External replication and real-world or clinical benefit were not established by the reviewed study.
evidence.ai_role: subtype-specific logistic models used echo variables, with/without an AI-derived ECG probability, and a temporally distinct test cohort.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
